argv.description: argv[0] is the program to exec

tty.description: If true, allocate a pseudo-terminal (crun exec --tty) for shells and line editing.

rows.description: Initial PTY height (optional). Sent by nyx for `-t` when stdin is a TTY.

cols.description: Initial PTY width (optional). Sent by nyx for `-t` when stdin is a TTY.

application/x-nyxd-exec+v1.description: JSON header line (ExecRequest) then raw stdin until EOF.
